blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Super Typhoon Rosal, internationally known as Champi, weakened into a typhoon Thursday afternoon, Oct. 22, the state weather bureau reported. In its weather advisory, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said Rosal had slightly weakened as of 2 p.m. As of 3 p.m., Rosal was located 360 kilometers east of Itbayat, Batanes, according to Pagasa’s latest track. It had maximum sustained winds of 165 kph near the center and gusts of up to 205 kph. The typhoon was moving northwest at 15 kph, Pagasa said.
